## Checklist
- [ ] Tests added for new logic
- [ ] `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` is clean
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed (README, docs/LIMITATIONS.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as relevant)
- [ ] If this changes `report.json`'s shape: `schema_version` bumped and called out here explicitly
- [ ] If this touches `internal/memoryaudit`: flagged for two-reviewer review per CONTRIBUTING.md
